title: mw.recon.exception.v1
description: One state change of a reconciliation exception (ticket 127b, FRS DAT-01 recon.exception, UC-22): OPEN when raised, EXPLAINED on an explanation, ACTIONED when an approved maker-checker action (mw-admin-api RECON_EXCEPTION) was taken, RESOLVED when the action's outcome was seen on mw.txn.status.v1. Key: exceptionId. mw-recon reports; it never posts money or changes a transaction. Consumers: mw-audit-dw (audit trail); mw-data-export reads it with a local shape (ticket 128).

amountMinor.description: The amount in question in poisha (absolute): for a trust position gap (detail TRUST_POSITION) the difference of the two balances, else the file amount, else the Upay amount, else the ledger amount

statementRef.description: The partner ref, else the txn id, else the statement reference (masked, cut to 255), else the exception id

action.description: ACTIONED and RESOLVED: the approved action

changeRequestId.description: ACTIONED and RESOLVED: the mw-admin-api change request

actor.description: EXPLAINED: the operator; ACTIONED: the checker; absent for system changes
